target.notes: This service map describes the current shipped GUIDE USB layout.

services.name: guide-desktop-windows
services.notes: The visible Windows launcher runs .internal/launch.vbs, which starts USB Ollama and then opens Guide.exe.

services.name: guide-desktop-macos
services.notes: The visible Mac app is a shell launcher that prepares USB Ollama, clears quarantine attributes, and then opens the internal Guide.app.

services.name: guide-desktop-linux
services.notes: The Linux shell launcher starts USB Ollama, opens the bundled Linux app, and stops Ollama when the app exits.

services.name: ollama-macos
services.notes: The Mac launcher kills conflicting host Ollama processes when needed so Review Picture can see USB vision models.

services.name: guide-library
services.notes: The reviewed USB includes a local library database and related files.

services.name: guide-maps
services.notes: The reviewed USB includes USA and world PMTiles map files.

services.name: guide-whisper
services.notes: The reviewed USB includes whisper binaries/assets including ggml-tiny.en.bin.
